title: Meet Our Volunteers - Elevate Branson
summary: We have some of the best volunteers on earth! Meet a few of the awesome people that make Elevate Branson a success. These wonderful folks and many more like them keep this organization going, growing, serving and elevating our neighbors and our community.

paragraphs: We have some of the best volunteers on earth! Meet a few of the awesome people that make Elevate Branson a success. These wonderful folks and many more like them keep this organization going, growing, serving and elevating our neighbors and our community.

Sally is one of our most valued volunteers in our Elevate Thrift Store. Being a non-profit, it is incredibly helpful to have a clean, enticing and friendly thrift store to help raise funding for our many programs and outreach opportunities. We value our customers and community that support our mission by donating items and shopping with us in the store. Sally shares that, “I have volunteered most of  my adult life….being at Elevate Branson brings it to a new level.” Sally has also mentored in our Elevate Work Program, giving of her time for a nine-week class to help a student move forward in their life by coming alongside them with encouragement and guidance. Sally keeps coming back as she values the “Camaraderie of people volunteering and working there”. Thank you Sally for your commitment and hard work!

Shane has been volunteering with us at in our Elevate Kids Program and Thursday Night Meal Delivery since 2017 and has been a great addition to our mission. Shane has shared that “Volunteering helps me feel better about myself and gives me purpose, It makes me feel like I am a part of a greater picture. Getting to see the after school program and summer school program grow keeps me coming back. Building relationships year after year with the kids is an investment that pays off”. Shane, being a third grade teacher at Buchanan Elementary School in Branson, has much to offer the kids that come to our programs. Thursday Night Meal Delivery is also an area that Shane likes to serve with as it “Gives me the opportunity to meet and talk to those in our community and offer support”. We are very grateful for Shane and the love he brings to the kids and adults we serve.

Frank has been faithfully handing out meals with us on our Thursday night Elevate Outreach program for almost a whole year! In conversation about what volunteering means to him, Frank expressed his love for “extending hospitality to those who don’t normally get it.” He also shared that volunteering not only “makes an impact on the people I serve, it totally makes an impact on me.” After describing one of his favorite scenarios to see while serving- families with children immediately sitting down to eat their sack lunch- he reflected, “how can you see that and not be moved by it and recognize that it does make an impact? It’s fun, and it’s rewarding.” Thank you, Frank, for loving our neighbors and for the joy you bring in serving!

Greg is an amazing, dependable and hard working volunteer in our Elevate Thrift Store for the past four years. It is not very often that Greg ever misses a shift that he has committed to is always ready to go – usually showing up early to get started. Greg has shared that, “I like helping people” and volunteering is “Something to do to vary my life since I retired.” With the amount of donations that we are blessed with, there is never a dull moment in the back room sorting and cleaning. Greg favorite part of volunteering is “I’ve made some friends, I hope I’ve helped some people somewhere”. You have Greg and we are very thankful for your dedication! Thank You!

Christina is a faithful volunteer in the Elevate Thrift Store, and we’re so thankful for her support! She can often be found in the intake section of our Thrift Store helping our staff manage and organize donation items. Christina is an invaluable member of our Thrift Store volunteer team, and we love having her around. Be sure to give Christina a big hug or a solid high-five next time you see her, and thank her for being a rock star volunteer!

Meet Cyndi DeWitt. Cyndi is a retired biblical counselor from a Christian recovery program in Memphis Tennessee. She counseled women who experienced addiction, abuse, imprisonment, and prostitution. One of her many responsibilities was to help get women job-ready to attempt to gain meaningful employment. After retiring, Cyndi still wanted to pour into women facing the same challenges. She found out about our Elevate Work program and has been an outstanding mentor for 5 classes. Not only has she poured into her students, she has been a fantastic organizer and communicator. She is currently the Mentor Coordinator, helping ensure communication with all of the mentors. We are so thankful for the many talents and experience that Cyndi brings to our campus. We are looking forward to seeing the transformational love that she shares with her students and our staff. In reflecting on life circumstances, Cyndi commented, “Elevate Branson is just where the Lord wants me to serve at this time in my life.” Thank you, Cyndi!

Kim is a loyal Thursday Morning Meal Make who always brings the energy! Her contagious smile lights up the room each week, and we count on her to read our weekly verse during circle up each Thursday morning. Kim is often accompanied by members of her family (shout out to runner up Volunteer of the Month, Kim’s husband, Paul) who always comes ready to serve just as passionately as she does. Give Kim a high-five or a hug this month and let her know how much we appreciate her dedication to our Thursday Morning Meal Making crew.

Jodi is a faithful and consistent volunteer who serves our Elevate Kids during our afterschool program. We’re thankful for all the ways Jodi loves our area kiddos through her commitment to serving our neighbors and their families. Jodi mentions, “I enjoy building relationships with the kids and getting to work with Elevate Branson. It has humbled me to see some of the struggles our neighbors deal with, and it helps me to understand their situation to be more patient, understanding, and empathetic.” We’re thankful for Jodi, and all of our Elevate Kids volunteers!

Karen not only serves as a Thursday Morning Meal Maker, she also spends her Tuesdays and Thursdays volunteering with Elevate Kids! Karen has several years of experience in education, and is an incredible asset to both our Elevate Kids and Thursday Morning Meal Making teams. We’re thankful for Karen and her love for our kiddos in our after-school program, as well as for our neighbors in our community.

Buddy Burns is a devoted mentor for our Elevate Work students and is faithful to show up for his mentees with love, compassion and support. Buddy has been volunteering as a mentor in several classes, and each of his students has testified of his unwavering commitment to seeing them succeed both in the class and beyond. We’re thankful for Buddy and his dedication to the Elevate Work program and the time and energy he devotes towards seeing our neighbors accomplish their action plan, find their passion, and discover their identity.

“I started volunteering after a friend invited me one Thursday. It didn’t take long to realize all that Elevate was doing to impact the community. Volunteering at Elevate consistently has really helped me realize how much of a passion I have  for helping people in our community. Being able  to go out and help on Thursday nights has been  a major blessing.”
We’re thankful for Ethan, his consistency during Thursday Night Meal Delivery, and his passion for connecting with and serving our neighbors!

Barbara has been a dedicated Thursday Morning Meal Maker for nearly 5 years (that equals out to making 147,980 sandwiches!) Here’s what Barbara had to say about her experience volunteering on Thursday mornings:

“I think more and more about the people that receive our meals and I thank God that I can be a part of it. What keeps me coming back is just everything! The other volunteers, the recipients of the meals, the joy of serving, the news of great things happening at Elevate Branson. I love it all and hate ever missing a week. I can’t think of anything that isn’t my favorite part of volunteering, but I really love the end result – when the meals are delivered and love is shared with all that receive them.”
We’re thankful for Barbara’s dedication to Thursday Mornings and our Meal Making crew!

Suzie and her daughter, Anna, actively serve with Elevate Kids, ensuring our area children receive nutritional, educational and social resources regularly. Suzie and Anna have both volunteered with Elevate Kids for our summer and after school programs. Suzie serves as an early childhood educator, and Anna shares the same love for investing in children as her mom. When asked how volunteering has impacted them personally, Suzie mentioned, “Volunteering at Elevate Branson for the past five years has softened my heart towards our neighbors. Every person we encounter has a story that can give us insight into their struggles and triumphs if we take the time to listen and build relationships with them. I am reminded daily that we are all God’s people and a little kindness goes a long way.” Anna replied similarly, saying, “Over the years that I’ve volunteered at Elevate, I’ve noticed tremendous self-growth in myself. I’ve become a much kinder person due to a newfound understanding. I’ve learned to never judge someone, especially not for what their life seems to be on the surface.”
We are so thankful for Suzie and Anna’s compassion for our neighbors and their children, and love serving our community with them!

Jeff and D’Ann faithfully serve our neighbors each Thursday through Elevate Outreach, and Jeff can often be found behind the wheel – driving hundreds of our Elevate Outreach sack meals and a handful of our volunteers to various extended stay motels in our community. Jeff and D’Ann mention their favorite part of volunteering is getting to see the kids, and the excitement on their faces after receiving a simple meal. “Volunteering helps us to look past our own issues and the stress of current life circumstances and focus on the needs of others,” Jeff and D’Ann mention, “It helps us count our many blessings and unite with others around the love and grace of our God.”
Thanks for your commitment to love our neighbors, Jeff and D’Ann!

We are thankful for Whitney’s commitment to her Elevate Work student as a mentor! Mentors play a crucial role in helping our students achieve their accomplishments and reach milestones throughout the Elevate Work course and beyond. It’s with the help of volunteers like Whitney that we see our neighbors reach new heights each and every day.

“Returning from missionary service in Uruguay in March 2020, there were few opportunities to serve. I checked around I came across Elevate Branson . I stopped and was told that Thursday sack meals were going to be delivered that evening and they would really like me to join them. I returned and enjoyed feeling the warmth of serving. I was given a card to call Amy Stallings and upon a very animated conversation, I returned to make sandwiches on the following Thursday morning. It was announced that help was needed in the Thrift Store, so I signed up there too. I have been impressed by the Christian values in which Elevate Branson integrates into their programs to “elevate” families and individuals in the community. It is a joy, it’s fun, and it feels uplifting to be part of all those good people in the Branson area who volunteer their time at Elevate Branson .”
We’re thankful for people like Josie who commit wholeheartedly to serving our community!

“My favorite part about volunteering is getting to know each and every person’s story. A lot of times you only see a person for their outward appearances – for what they’re doing, or not doing. But when you actually get to take the time to sit down and hear their story, hear where they come from and what they’ve walked through, it gives you the insight and compassion to walk this journey along with them.”

We are thankful for Whitney’s commitment to her Elevate Work student as a mentor! Mentors play a crucial role in helping our students achieve their accomplishments and reach milestones throughout the Elevate Work course and beyond. It’s with the help of volunteers like Whitney that we see our neighbors reach new heights each and every day.

Paul is a consistent Thursday morning AND Thursday evening volunteer, who even sacrifices part of his Wednesday afternoon to ensure everything is set up and ready to go for both Thursday outreach programs. Paul loves our neighbors and loves to serve (second to his love for golf) and we’re thankful for his consistency and compassion for our community. Be sure to give Paul a high-five next time you see him!
